statement: The top three customers are estimated to hold more than 85% of TSMC CoWoS capacity, with NVIDIA at roughly 60% (about 595,000 wafers) and booking more than half of the 2026-2027 CoWoS expansion.
why: If three buyers hold the great majority of advanced-packaging capacity and one of them has pre-booked most of the expansion, everyone else competes for a small residual, regardless of how much capacity is added.

impact.mechanism: Concentrated pre-booking of packaging capacity crowds out smaller accelerator designers, limiting effective supply available to the rest of the market.

evidence.excerpt: Top three customers combined share ">85%" of CoWoS capacity.

confidence.basis: Secondary analysis site estimate; the document labels the NVIDIA share as estimated and no primary foundry disclosure corroborates it.
